name: rideguard
description: RideGuard rider risk-advisory web application (Next.js + NestJS).

scripts.dev:model: cd apps/model && (python3 -m uvicorn service:app --port 8000 || uvicorn service:app --port 8000)
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @rideguard/api && npm run build --workspace @rideguard/web
scripts.lint: echo "add eslint per app as needed"
